description: Flatbread with olive oil, eaten during the harvest. Eaten hot, or eaten cold later, and both are correct.
energy_note: It is good. That is the whole of layer one.

description: The shopping, the chopping, the waiting, the smell filling the place forty minutes before anyone eats. For a lot of people this is the better half.
energy_note: The kitchen smelling of it, before anyone sits down.

description: Almost no one lists a meal among their best days because of the food. They list it because of the table. The Harvard Study has been saying a version of this for eighty-seven years.
notes: Harvard Study of Adult Development: relationship quality is the strongest predictor of health and happiness.

description: Money for ingredients, a working cooker, somewhere to sit, and people free at the same time. Any of those can fail.
energy_note: Four ordinary things, and any of them can be missing.

description: Eventually you make it the way one specific person made it, including the part they did wrong, because that is how it is supposed to taste.
